law_name: Copyright and Neighbouring Rights Act, 2000 (Cap. 68:02; as amended by Act No. 6 of 2006)
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (collective, audiovisual, anonymous and pseudonymous works: 50 years from publication; applied art: 25 years from creation)
enforcement_body: Companies and Intellectual Property Authority (CIPA) - Copyright Office
